Industry-leading location intelligence boosts fleet efficiency and driver safety


WESTMINSTER, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026


— Trimble announced a major expansion to Trimble Places, its database of truck-specific locations with highly-detailed location data for more than six million commercial vehicle locations across North America and Europe. More than just location data, Trimble’s proprietary directory of places targets some of the transportation industry’s most expensive and high-risk challenges, which includes unpaid driver detention and hazardous final-mile navigation. Providing fleets with information such as precise polygonal geofences, truck-specific entry and exit gates, and facility dwell times helps to improve efficiency, final-mile safety and ETA accuracy.


Originally launched in 2022, Trimble Places are coded with relevant location attributes such as operating hours, phone numbers, gate notes and more, increasing location and amenity visibility for fleet managers and improving overall experience for drivers.


Driver detention and final-mile navigation continue to drain productivity and heighten safety risks across the transportation sector. According to the


[American Transportation Research Institute](https://truckingresearch.org/2024/09/new-research-documents-substantial-financial-and-safety-impacts-from-truck-driver-detention/) (ATRI), detention cost the trucking industry $3.6 billion in direct expenses and $11.5 billion in lost productivity in 2023. ATRI notes while roughly 94 percent of fleets charge detention fees, fewer than half are paid. Tight final-mile spaces and long dwell times create hazards for large trucks. Trimble Places helps solve these challenges by combining live and historical GPS data with truck-specific entry and exit geofences to deliver wait time visibility, and reduce dwell times and dangerous tight space maneuvers.


By utilizing precise polygonal geofences that reflect a location’s physical boundaries rather than traditional, inaccurate circular geofence boundaries, fleets can more accurately capture exact GPS entry and exit data in Trimble Places. This eliminates false alerts, provides supportable proof of wait times, and helps close costly billing gaps. Coded with detailed location attributes, Trimble Places reduces dangerous tight-space maneuvers. Combining anonymized live and historical GPS data streams with its millions of locations, Trimble Places offers vital transparency around facility dwell times. This increased visibility reduces driver frustration, improves ETA accuracy for customers, and creates a safer, more predictable day for the driver.


Built-In Location Intelligence with Trimble CoPilot 11.4


The expansion of Places comes fully integrated into the newly updated


[Trimble CoPilot 11.4](https://transportation.trimble.com/en/solutions/mapping-and-routing/copilot) , which features new vehicle configuration controls for safer, highly compliant truck routing. CoPilot 11.4 introduces a more dynamic, server-generated routing capability that synchronizes back-office planning with real-time in-cab navigation, protecting contracted mileage calculations while maintaining reliable offline truck guidance.


Additionally, CoPilot enhances the driver experience through strategic integrations by offering truck-friendly hotel booking via travel management platform Engine and access to over 90,000 bookable parking spots through Truck Parking Club. A voice-enabled AI Driver Assistant is built in to minimize in-cab distractions and make it easier for drivers to manage trips, locate rest stops, discover new features and submit end-of-trip feedback.


“While expanding our directory to over six million commercial locations is a massive milestone of scale, the real value lies in how this precise intelligence transforms daily operations and profitability for our customers,” said Michael Kornhauser, sector vice president of transportation & logistics at Trimble. “Trimble is in the unique position to provide this proprietary commercial location intelligence across our portfolio — including in-cab navigation solutions like CoPilot — to create efficiencies, increase safety and improve driver satisfaction across the transportation industry.”


Availability


Trimble Places is integrated across the Trimble ecosystem, including key industry standard solutions such as


[Trimble CoPilot](https://transportation.trimble.com/en/solutions/mapping-and-routing/copilot) navigation and


[Trimble PC*Miler](https://transportation.trimble.com/en/solutions/mapping-and-routing/pcmiler) . It is also available as a standalone API integration.


Additional integration points include transportation management software


[Trimble TMW.Suite, TruckMate and Innovative TMS](https://transportation.trimble.com/en/solutions/transportation-management) and McLeod TMS. It also integrates with Platform Science Fleet Manager and companion web applications like ContentTools, which lets customers add and manage private locations.
